# Community Rule Column 4 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 4 | **Condition:** complete

---

**4:1** a spirit of humility and patience, abundant compassion and perpetual goodness,

**4:2** and insight and understanding and mighty wisdom, trusting in all the deeds of God

**4:3** and leaning on His abundant lovingkindness; a spirit of knowledge in every plan of action,

**4:4** and zeal for righteous judgments, and a holy purpose with a steadfast inclination,

**4:5** and abundant lovingkindness toward all the Sons of Truth, and glorious purity, abhorring all the idols of defilement,

**4:6** and walking humbly with prudence in all things, and concealing the truth of the mysteries of knowledge. These are the counsels of the spirit for the Sons of Truth in the world. And the visitation of all who walk in it shall be:

**4:7** healing and great peace in length of days, fruitfulness of offspring together with all everlasting blessings,

**4:8** and eternal joy in life everlasting, and a crown of glory together with garments of majesty in eternal light.

**4:9** But to the spirit of deceit belong these: greed of soul, slackness of hands in the service of righteousness, wickedness and falsehood,

**4:10** pride and haughtiness of heart, deceitfulness and cruelty, great impatience,

**4:11** much folly and brazen insolence, abominable deeds committed in a spirit of lewdness, and ways of defilement in the service of impurity,

**4:12** a blaspheming tongue, blindness of eyes and heaviness of ears, stiffness of neck and hardness of heart,

**4:13** so as to walk in all the ways of darkness and evil cunning. And the visitation of all who walk in it shall be:

**4:14** an abundance of afflictions at the hands of all the angels of destruction, in the pit of everlasting fire, eternal perdition through the furious vengeance of God,

**4:15** perpetual terror and everlasting disgrace, together with the shame of extinction in the fire of the dark regions. And all their appointed seasons, generation after generation, shall be spent in sorrowful mourning and bitter misery,

**4:16** in dark calamities until their destruction, with neither remnant nor survivor among them.

**4:17** In these two spirits walk the generations of all the sons of humanity, and in their divisions all the hosts of them receive their inheritance, generation by generation.

**4:18** In the ways of the two spirits they walk. And the full reward of their deeds is determined by the division to which they belong, whether much or little, throughout all the ages of eternity.

**4:19** For God has set them in equal portions until the final end, and He has placed everlasting enmity between their divisions.

**4:20** The deeds of deceit are an abomination to truth, and all the ways of truth are an abomination to deceit. Fierce contention marks all their judgments,

**4:21** for they do not walk together. But God, in the mysteries of His understanding and in the wisdom of His glory, has appointed an end for the existence of injustice,

**4:22** and at the time of the visitation He will destroy it forever. Then truth shall arise in the world forever, for the world has wallowed in the ways of wickedness

**4:23** under the dominion of injustice until the appointed time of the decreed judgment. Then God will purify by His truth all the deeds of every man,

**4:24** and He will refine for Himself the body of man, to consume every spirit of injustice from within his flesh,

**4:25** and to cleanse him by a holy spirit from all wicked deeds. He will sprinkle upon him a spirit of truth like purifying waters,

**4:26** to cleanse him from all the abominations of falsehood and from the defilement of an impure spirit, so as to instruct the upright in the knowledge of the Most High and in the wisdom of the Sons of Heaven, to give wisdom to the blameless of way. For God has chosen them for an everlasting covenant, and to them belongs all the glory of Adam.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering of 1QS Column 4. "Lovingkindness" renders hesed. "Sons of Truth" and "Sons of Heaven" capitalized as sectarian community designations. "Glory of Adam" preserved as a technical Qumran eschatological phrase denoting restoration. "Body of man" at 4:24 renders yetser in its physical sense.*
